name: Claude Skill Self Improvement
headline: Self-improvement AI with Claude skills
short_description: Analyzes Claude conversation history to identify friction patterns and generate concrete suggestions for improving your CLAUDE.md configuration and skills.
author: bokan

sections.overview:
Self-Improving Claude reads your conversation history across sessions to identify friction patterns—moments where things went wrong or could work better. The skill spawns parallel agents to cross-reference these patterns against your existing CLAUDE.md and skills, then generates a ranked report with concrete suggestions for configuration updates. You review the output and apply improvements that make sense for your workflow, creating a feedback loop where Claude's performance improves over time based on real usage data.
Identify recurring problems in Claude interactions and fix them systematically
Discover gaps in your CLAUDE.md configuration based on actual conversation friction
Find opportunities to create new skills by analyzing where Claude struggled
Optimize prompts and instructions by learning what already works well
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/bokan/claude-skill-self-improvement`
sections.usage:
```
Analyze my previous interactions with you where I've had to correct you. Identify patterns in your mistakes and suggest improvements for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Use this data: [DATA].
```
Copy

```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
